summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on record Q1 2026 BJJLink activity, with 216,176 student check-ins (up 105% YoY) and over 1.42 million cumulative check-ins. The filing reports operational metrics and platform growth, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural changes are present. As a routine current report of operating results, this is not classified as a special situation.
